Background

About Ricky Lee Pinzon

Ricky Lee Pinzon is an independent legal researcher and writer based in the County of Los Angeles, California. His work spans civil procedure, appellate practice, California superior court litigation, and the intersection of law, digital identity protection, and public accountability.

Drawing on years of hands-on engagement with court systems and public records, Ricky has focused on understanding how personal data is managed and occasionally misused. He uses accessible tools—including scripting, automation, and PowerShell workflows—to develop methods that help individuals regain control over their personal narratives when targeted by low-quality or malicious online content.

In addition to his technical research, Ricky is an author and self-publisher preparing several original works focused on procedural justice. He is an advocate for digital safety, library preservation, and the ethical deployment of technology within the public research domain.

When not writing, Ricky pursues interests in herpetology, electronics, and community-oriented projects in Los Angeles.
